title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
To bring about the realisation of human rights for poor and marginalised men and women affected by high inequality, human rights violations and violence in seven conflict or post-conflict countries by addressing issues of governance, tackling violence, building peace and promoting equality for all, particularly gender equality. Outcome 2.1: Peace building policies and agreements reflect partners’ and CA’s advocacy to increase justice and security for all citizens of IoPt.
Outcome 2.2: There is greater safety and resilience for marginalised citizens of IoPt as they negotiate their daily lives. Objective 2: Marginalised women and men facing violence have greater safety, security and resilience, and inclusive peace building initiatives contribute to lasting justice.
